observations: QA start/end cross entropies average over feature examples; position equal to sequence length is ignored. Planned feature labels remain strictly in-range, including CLS=0 out-of-window labels.
BERT LayerNorm/attention is per sequence; dropout remains stochastic and microbatching need not preserve pathwise masks.
Checkpointing uses GradientCheckpointingLayer wrappers; checkpoint kwargs are explicit, RNG preservation required.
SDPA delegates to native Torch scaled_dot_product_attention; the Python backend label does not identify the actual selected CUDA kernel.
Use direct local safetensors tensor loading and explicit builtin model class; no AutoModel/from_pretrained remote resolution is needed.
scope: Selected installed package entry points and BERT forward/loss, per-layer non-reentrant checkpoint wrapper, eager/SDPA dispatch, local tokenizer and safetensors loading paths. Not a whole-library security audit. Only builtin BertConfig/BertForQuestionAnswering and local tensor/tokenizer data may run; no downloaded script, remote model code, pickle checkpoint, trainer, flash-attention plugin or offload branch is authorized by this review.
